biocs.name: Rare Process Executed by AppleScript
biocs.description: Detection of a process being executed by osascript, which is uncommon and potentially malicious
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'osascript'
| filter action_process_image_name != 'osascript'
